title: Assemble kept collection members by boolean union
description: Merge the kept members of a collection (CRAW-12) into one mesh. Add a `merge_collection.dsl` pattern (or a small node if the graph gets unwieldy) that aligns each kept member to the first (rigid registration: PCA pre-alignment + ICP over sampled points, as an `align_to_mesh` node; manual override via transform_geometry literals), then chains mesh_boolean UNION in order, tagging every face with its source member via CRAW-13 provenance so the result can be tinted per scan and the user can see which generation each region came from. This is REFACTOR-PLAN-2 D7 (loaded models as boolean operands) done on real data. Handle non-watertight members by reporting, not repairing (repair is a separate ticket if needed). Related: MESH-50 (unwelded duplicates after mesh_boolean) will compound over a ten-member union chain.
definition-of-done:
1. Two crawfish scans: `merge_collection` produces one closed mesh in mesh-boolean scene, tinted by source member (screenshot). 2. align_to_mesh reduces mean nearest-point distance between two scans by at least 5x versus unaligned. 3. All ten members (kept) union in under 5 minutes on the dev machine or the ticket documents which stage dominates. 4. Non-manifold input is reported with member name and defect counts instead of a crash. 5. Build checkstyle-green.

6. The CollectionUnionReport fields mergedMemberCount, skippedMemberCount, outputVertexCount, outputFaceCount, outputBoundaryEdgeCount, outputNonManifoldEdgeCount, outputShellCount and untaggedFaceCount are the report of item 4; RigidAlignment's sourcePointCount and targetPointCount are the sampled cloud sizes the solve iterates over; the CrawfishCollectionMergeBenchmark lines '[merge]' are the timing and registration record of items 2 and 3.
testing-plan: 1. Unit: align_to_mesh on a torus and a rotated/translated copy recovers the transform within 1e-3. 2. Unit: union of three tagged cubes carries three member tags. 3. run-scene mesh-boolean with merge_collection on ~/crawfish (two members, then all kept).
unknowns: Whether union is the right operator at all when scans overlap almost completely (may want per-label part selection from members instead -- see CRAW-17)
Whether Manifold handles ~10M-triangle unions in memory

DoD 2 read literally (two different scans, the frame they arrive in) gives 2.4x, not 5x: Trellis2 outputs already share a canonical frame (0.058 start) and the 0.025 residual is pose/shape difference (claws, legs) a rigid transform cannot remove. The same pair displaced first reaches the same 0.024768 residual (9.0x). Decide whether the displaced-pair reading is the acceptance number.
IMG_4117's repair takes 150 s of the 254 s ten-member run (the other nine repair in 1-14 s); a repair_mesh performance follow-up, not a union problem.

Union output keeps each member's small debris shells (17 shells for two members, 68 for ten) and 1.3% of faces lose their member tag over ten unions (faceSourceQuad not mapping back); CRAW-14's Manifold merge-vector change may affect both.
changes-made: merge_collection node (MergeCollectionNode) + CollectionUnion: reads the collection.dsl keep flags, loads one kept member at a time (lazy loader; preloading all ten OOMed a 4 GB heap after four members), repairs it with repair_mesh's defaults, analyses it, registers it onto the first member, unions it in with Manifold and carries a per-face member index through every union via faceSourceQuad; merge_collection.dsl is the pattern.

align_to_mesh node (AlignToMeshNode) over RigidAlignment: principal-axis pre-alignment (four axis-flip candidates) then trimmed ICP with Horn's quaternion solve (SymmetricJacobiEigen) over stride-sampled vertices, nearest points from PointCloudGrid; buffers are fields reused across iterations. MeshRigidTransform is the vertex transform shared with transform_geometry.

CollectionUnionReport: per member input/operand V and F, watertight, boundary/non-manifold/unoriented edge counts, shells, align mean distance before->after, iterations, load/repair/analysis/align/union ms, running faces; a member that is still open or non-manifold after repair is skipped and named with its counts, never a crash. mesh-boolean scene with -Dixdar.model=<scan dir> runs merge_collection, tints each member one PatchColors hue and logs the report; M toggles two members / all kept.
Two scans (IMG_4109+IMG_4110): 10.19 s, V=667897 F=1335882, 0 boundary / 0 non-manifold edges, 17 shells, 432 untagged faces of 1335882; screenshot tmp/craw-16.png.

Ten kept members, CrawfishCollectionMergeBenchmark#mergeAllKeptMembers under the 4 GB test heap: 253.69 s, V=1297889 F=2596718, 0 boundary / 0 non-manifold edges, 68 shells, 34708 untagged faces. Stage totals: repair 177.8 s (IMG_4117 alone 150.1 s), union 47.3 s (3.6-7.2 s per member, growing with the running mesh), align 17.7 s, analysis 6.4 s, load 2.6 s. Repair dominates.

Registration (benchmark#registrationRecoversADisplacedScan): displaced IMG_4109 onto itself 0.191263 -> 0.000000 in 2 iterations; IMG_4110 onto IMG_4109 in the frame both arrive in 0.058241 -> 0.024768 (2.4x); IMG_4110 displaced (25 deg Y, 12 deg X, 0.35/-0.2/0.15) onto IMG_4109 0.223616 -> 0.024768 (9.0x). Unit: RigidAlignmentTest (torus and chiral fixture within 1e-3), CollectionUnionTest (three tagged cubes, open box reported and skipped).
